subject: Concerns about proposed parking on St Margaret's Grove – temple and school
body:
Dear Parking Design Team,

I am writing to raise serious concerns about the introduction of parking controls on St Margaret's Grove. My family and I visit the temple there regularly, and the proposed scheme would create a real problem for us. I am here to find peace when I worship, but I am worried about getting tickets every time I come to pray.

Elderly worshippers and others visiting the temple should not have to pay to pray. I also understand the school on St Margaret's Grove would be affected. Please consider exemptions or dedicated provision for temple visitors and school users before any scheme is introduced.

Kind regards,
[Your name]
[Your address]
[Your contact details]
